{"action":"shell","command":"python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/testbed/HANDOFF.md'
s=open(p).read()
old='''## Unresolved / watch items
- R07/R08 (entry expiry) are referenced by the round-2 R05 clarification but
  are NOT part of the current milestone input: no expiry behavior is specified
  or implemented yet. FR-019 constrains any future expiry state; re-run
  specify/plan when R07/R08 arrive.
'''
new='''## Milestone 3 (R07/R08) - specify phase updated 2026-10-17
- R07/R08 ARE now active requirements (milestone 3 retains R01-R06).
  Spec.md updated: User Story 5 (TTL), FR-022..FR-028, SC-009/SC-010,
  edge cases, Key Entities (Entry expiry, Timer), Assumptions A12/A13,
  traceability rows for R07/R08. Checklist re-validated (all pass).
- FR-019 (round-2 R05 clarification) is now fully in scope: resize MUST
  preserve each surviving entry's absolute expiry; must not drop expiries or
  recompute them from resize time. FR-026 purge happens before resize and
  does not recompute surviving expiries (consistent).
- R07: timer=None default time.monotonic; put ttl=None (no expiry) or finite
  nonnegative int/float excluding bool -> expiry = timer()+ttl; invalid TTL
  ValueError before mutation; ttl=0 immediately expired; exact boundary
  (timer()==expiry) is expired (inclusive).
- R08: purge expired before get/put/len/resize/invalidation without touching
  survivor recency; overwrite replaces prior expiry; invalidation counts only
  live entries; missing/expired get raises KeyError; no-timer/ttl callers
  unchanged.
'''
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
# update assumptions list line to mention A12/A13
old2='''  dedupes request tags, count = distinct removed keys (A11).'''
new2='''  dedupes request tags, count = distinct removed keys (A11); TTL value class
  and absolute-expiry computation (A12); purge/recency non-interference (A13).'''
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2,1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('ok handoff updated')
PYEOF"}
